description: Hooks for the no-code-method plugin. SessionStart injects the universal behavioural rules at session start (and on resume/clear/compact). PreToolUse runs four checks on Edit/Write/MultiEdit (locked-doc read-only, Serves-line resolution, batch file-list boundary) and one check on Task (test-confirmation gate on no-code-method:batch-executor invocations — V27). Stop redirects Claude either to the after-build subagent when a batch has just finished, or back into the top unticked build batch in BACKLOG.md (auto-continuation; respects `stop_hook_active` for one-redirect-per-turn). UserPromptSubmit was the original choice for SessionStart's job but is blocked by anthropics/claude-code#10225; SessionStart works in plugins today and is functionally equivalent given the method's /clear-after-every-build discipline.
